_readme: Single source of truth for the Creator DAO Certificate collection. Edit this file, then run `npm run nft:metadata` to regenerate all 10,000 metadata files. See NFT_ISSUANCE_GUIDE.md.

collection.name: Block Label Creator DAO Certificate
collection.description: The Block Label Creator DAO Certificate is a limited series of 10,000 membership certificates issued by the Block Label Foundation on BNB Smart Chain. Each certificate carries a unique serial number and grants its holder access to the Block Label IP wholesale market, tiered membership benefits, and Creator DAO governance participation.

image._note: CONFIRMED 2026-08-14 by reading the IPFS directory listing: 10,000 files named 1.jpg .. 10000.jpg, no zero padding, no gaps. `pattern` supports {id} (raw token id) and {pad} (zero-padded to serialPadding). `startIndex` is the file number that corresponds to token id 1 — set to 0 if the uploaded files are 0-indexed.
